svg.title: Sequence: expanding a record-type group in the Plugin view
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram across five participants: user, UI thread, judge worker thread, session lock, and tes3conv. Shows lazy row insertion in batches, then background judging with the lock held per plugin read.
svg.text: UI stays responsive from here on
…one acquire per plugin, never per record
The lock is held for one plugin read at a time. Wrapping the whole batch is what froze the window.
